captions.detailed: A telescoping desk lamp featuring a weighted, dark rectangular base and a three-stage vertical support post. The post consists of nested metallic tubes with tightening knobs, allowing for height adjustment. Extending from the top of the post is a dual-segment articulating arm connected by hinged elbow joints, holding a dark blue conical lamp shade with a visible yellow bulb inside. It features prismatic sliding joints for the telescopic post, and revolute joints at the elbow hinges and the lamp shade connection for tilting.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a telescoping desk lamp. The lamp must feature a heavy rectangular base, a three-stage telescoping vertical post with adjustment thumbscrews, a dual-link articulating arm connected via revolute elbow joints, and a conical lamp shade that tilts on a revolute joint at the end of the arm.
captions.factory: The design is constructed as an ArticulatedObject. The base is created using a Box primitive, with a cylindrical collar. The telescoping post is built from three nested Cylinder primitives representing the lower, middle, and upper tubes, complete with small cylindrical thumbscrews. The dual-link arm is composed of parallel thin cylinders connected by blocky joints (modeled with Box primitives). The lamp shade is constructed by combining a hollowed cone (or Cylinder) with a spherical lightbulb inside. Prismatic joints connect the three vertical post stages, while revolute joints connect the arm links and the tilting lamp shade.
